en.headline: Hong Kong takes two sailing golds in youth 29er events
en.dek: The men's and women's youth 29er crews both won in Nagoya, a day that also included an ILCA 7 silver.
body: Hong Kong added two sailing golds at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Friday, winning both the men's and women's youth 29er events.

In the men's class, the 15-year-old pair of Kiu Ho-hang and Pou Ling-hang finished first in all 12 races, RTHK reported. After the worst race was discarded, their net score was 11 points, 24 points clear of Singapore in second.
In the women's event, Kong Tsz-ki and Wong Hei-wai took nine race wins. Their net score of 14 points put them first, ahead of Japan on 20 and Malaysia on 34.
With Pui Chun-lung's silver in the men's ILCA 7 earlier on Friday, Hong Kong's sailing team collected two golds and one silver on the day. The ILCA result had already been reported separately.

zh.headline: 亞運帆船青年29人級港隊再奪兩金
zh.dek: 男女子青年快速艇29人級均稱冠，連同ILCA 7銀牌，帆船隊單日兩金一銀。
body: 香港隊周五在名古屋亞運帆船賽再添兩面金牌，分別贏得男子及女子青年快速艇29人級。
港台報道，男子組由15歲的喬澔鏗及普令行拍檔出賽，12輪賽事全部首名完成。計最佳11輪後淨得分11分，領先第二名新加坡隊24分。
女子組江芷棋及黃曦慧在12輪中有9輪首名衝線，扣除最差一輪後淨得分14分排名第一。日本隊以20分得銀，馬來西亞隊以34分得銅。
連同貝俊龍同日較早時在男子單人艇ILCA 7級奪得的銀牌，帆船隊單日進帳兩金一銀。ILCA 7的賽果已另行報道。
